dataformat.name: base64
dataformat.title: Base64
dataformat.description: Encode and decode data using Base64
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation

marshalIn.description: The bytes to encode: text in the charset of the exchange, bytes, a stream or a file

marshalOut.description: The Base64 text in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

unmarshalOut.description: The decoded bytes, as a stream

lineLength.description: To specific a maximum line length for the encoded data. By default 76 is used.

lineSeparator.label: advanced
lineSeparator.description: The line separators to use. By default \r\n is used.

urlSafe.label: advanced
urlSafe.description: Instead of emitting and / we emit - and _ respectively. urlSafe is only applied to encode operations. Decoding seamlessly handles both modes.
